job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

- Implementing quality engineering standards in software development and testing processes
- Identifying and resolving software defects to optimize performance and enhance user experience
- Conducting functional, compatibility, and performance testing to validate software quality
- Utilizing Selenium for browser automation and software testing
- Designing and managing quality assurance processes and metrics to improve software reliability
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate systems and validate seamless software functionality
- Generating and executing test cases and protocols to support software quality assurance
- Providing post go-live support to address any software issues and improve user satisfaction
- Engaging in process improvement initiatives to enhance quality assurance methodologies
- Building a personal brand by consistently delivering quality work and contributing to team success
job.ai_reason: Strong production AI experience but no Selenium or QA testing tools.
